adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the `Topic.transaction` will complete even if `creator.create` returns `nil`, because there is no `raise`/rollback path when `post` is blank; in that case no `TopicEmbed` row is created (`TopicEmbed.create!` is conditional on `post.present?`). However, the finding’s stronger claim (that a topic is nonetheless created, causing duplicates and “Loading forever”) is not directly verifiable from this diff because `PostCreator#create`’s persistence/return semantics aren’t shown here. What is verifiable is the missing failure handling/rollback when `creator.create` returns nil.
